<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Nasty Mule 87</title>
<style>
/* Nasty Mule 87 by sujithg444 — https://uiverse.io/sujithg444/nasty-mule-87 */
.gradient-button {
  background: linear-gradient(
    to right,
    #ff5370,
    #ff869a
  );
  border: none;
  color: white;
  padding: 10px 20px;
  border-radius: 25px;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: bold;
  text-shadow: 0px 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
  box-shadow: 0px 2px 5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
}
.gradient-button:hover {
  box-shadow: 0px 4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="gradient-button">⚡ Join now</button>

</body>
</html>
